title: Cart quantity and total after refresh

behavior.actions: Click Reset cart. Click Increase quantity exactly once. In the same tab, navigate directly to ${appUrl} one more time to reload the cart. Leave its buttons untouched after that navigation.
behavior.expected: After the reload, Quantity is 2 and Cart total is $48.00.

fp_total_readout.label: Cart total
fp_total_readout.read: the exact visible Cart total including its currency symbol

controls.actions: Click Reset cart. Click Increase quantity exactly once. Remain on the page without reloading.
controls.expected: Immediately after increasing, Quantity is 2 and Cart total is $48.00.

fp_total_readout.label: Cart total
fp_total_readout.read: the exact visible Cart total including its currency symbol
